n = int(input())
arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
t = int(input())

arr.sort()

maxCount = 0
for i in range(n):
    count = 1
    remaining = t
    for j in range(i + 1, n):
        diff = arr[j] - arr[j-1]
        if diff > remaining:
            break
        remaining -= diff
        count += 1
    if count > maxCount:
        maxCount = count

print(maxCount)
